details: dir              Published site directory; default: public
--headed         Show the browser window
--trace          Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>      Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>   Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>    Page that declares the rules; default: /
--expect <mode>  Expected rules mode: inline or off; default: inline
--eager <rules>  Expected eager prefetch rule IDs, separated by commas
swban check/browser/prefetch/rules ./preview --page /all/ --eager folder/tail
swban check/browser/prefetch/rules ./preview --expect off

zh.summary: 浏览器实际接收并解析规则；Chromium
details: dir              已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed         显示浏览器窗口
--trace          保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>      在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>   浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>    声明预取规则的页面；默认：/
--expect <mode>  预期规则模式：inline 或 off；默认：inline
--eager <rules>  预期的 eager 预取规则 ID，用逗号分隔
swban check/browser/prefetch/rules ./preview --page /all/ --eager folder/tail
swban check/browser/prefetch/rules ./preview --expect off
